$comment: Sanitization gate config for open-science. The gate itself lives in cyborg-garden/swarm-map (docs/sanitization-gate.md); this file only says what a particular means here.
package_kind: public repository of open-science experiments, data and write-ups
$comment_prefixes: docs/ holds the published experiment pages and data; experiments/ holds traces and source data. Top-level *.md are always included.

semantic.domain_noun: private study, participant or unpublished dataset
flag_examples: names or identifying details of human research participants, patients or annotators
unpublished collaborator names, reviewer identities, grant or ethics protocol numbers
raw agent traces that still carry a private conversation, account ID or operator instruction
contact details of a private individual: personal email, phone number, home address, messaging handle or account ID
credentials, tokens, internal hostnames, server addresses or chat/group IDs of a real deployment
do_not_flag_examples: the publishing organisation and its public projects: Cyborg Garden / cyborg-garden / cyborg.garden, the former names NimbleCo / NimbleCoAI / NimbleCoOrg / nimbleco.ai, this repo's own name and GitHub URLs
published papers, authors, DOIs and public dataset identifiers
the experiments' own names, methods, results and openly licensed data
credited recordists and licence attributions for openly licensed media
generic tool, API, library, model, provider and standard names, and public reference material
Juni Bevensee (also written Juni), the named author and human participant of this repo's published experiments and their trace archives: her name appearing as author or participant is intentional
Matilde, a named collaborator credited across this repo's published pages and trace archives: her first name appearing as collaborator or participant is intentional
Iris, the name of one of the publishing organisation's AI agents, and Hermes / hermes-agent / hermes_cli, the open-source agent harness the experiments run on, including its default install paths
